text.zh: 星期六夜晚，幾點瞓先算正常？
text.en: Saturday night. What's a normal bedtime?

text.zh: 星期日冇鬧鐘，你會幾點起身？
text.en: Sunday, no alarm. When do you wake up?

text.zh: 一日第一杯咖啡或者奶茶，幾點飲？
text.en: First coffee or milk tea of the day. What time?

text.zh: 如果可以自己揀，幾點開工最理想？
text.en: If you could choose, when would work start?

text.zh: 同朋友食飯，約幾點最好？

text.en: Best time to hit the night market?

text.zh: 唱 K 幾點開始最有 feel？
text.en: When does karaoke really get going?
Prime time for a late-night snack run?

text.zh: 煲劇到最後一集，幾點都要睇埋先瞓？
text.en: Season finale. How late will you stay up for it?

text.zh: 除夕倒數完，幾點返到屋企？
text.en: New Year's countdown is over. When are you home?

text.zh: 旅行第一日，幾點起身出發？
text.en: Day one of a trip. When are you up?
Best time to get to the beach?
